name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on B200

target.topology: single eight-GPU NVLink/NVSwitch node; DEP8 and two DEP4 are candidate layouts
target.workload: agent-style approximately 8K input / 1K output; 75% target cacheability is not measured cache-hit rate

baseline.note: Historical source pin and refreshed configuration are distinct. Check resolved active backend and MTP/DSpark state. Imported aggregate metrics do not establish bottlenecks.

paper_queries: speculative decoding adaptive draft length inference
mixture of experts inference communication overlap
constraints: Investigate negative evidence and branch/deployment applicability
instructions: Find useful improvements to the current serving system and cost/throughput Pareto frontier. Known techniques, parameter changes, feature activation, upstream ports, kernels, routing and vLLM source changes are allowed. Publication novelty is not required. Verify what the baseline already implements; if unknown, propose a cheap check. Do not invent measurements. Reconsider the previous low-M MoE shape-policy candidate for usefulness. Preserve its uncertainty. Do not seek a publication contribution.

# Decision — six new B200 inference-serving ideas

Research completed 2026-10-19 (Asia/Kolkata). This is a **ranked experiment-selection shortlist**, not a report of new measured gains or approval to patch/build/run GPUs. The imported `LAT-2XDEP4-R7b` c384 point is 27.6882 req/s, request TPOT p50/p99 12.850/19.329 ms, TTFT p99 2.180 s and reported cache-hit share 0.7736 on one eight-B200 node; it is one aggregate discovery run without a kernel, rank or request trace. Exact source/config/hardware limits are in [brief](brief.md). Each card's first serving point uses a contemporaneous unchanged R7b control and same request bodies, cache preparation, eight-GPU budget and load mode; candidate changes are recorded. A 120 s warmup + 150 s scored point per arm gives **1.2 GPU-hours of scheduled traffic for two arms**, excluding setup/build/startup/drain and any repeats. That is a planning baseline, not a required sample floor.

| Rank | Idea and expected benefit / tradeoff | Evidence and required change | Confidence / readiness | Cheapest informative next test → first measured serving point | Cost before/at point |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1** | [H04: DP-aligned prefill cadence](hypotheses/H04.md): less EP straggler wait and TPOT tail if misses desynchronize ranks; delayed TTFT possible. | Pinned `prefill_schedule_interval` exists and is unset in R7b; [#44558](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44558) review fixed saturation behavior. No rank-skew evidence. Config overlay interval 2. | Mechanism **moderate**, R7b benefit **low–moderate**; configuration screen after trace. | Short unchanged-parent per-rank prefill/collective trace and CPU replay → matched c384 parent vs interval 2. | Low engineering; trace startup unknown; 1.2 GPU-h traffic if promoted. |
| **2** | [H01: V4.1 SWA bounded replay](hypotheses/H01.md): trim upper-layer prefill and SWA cache work; approximate state may affect answers and graph overhead may regress. | [V4.1 paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.19969v1), [vLLM graph work #59532](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59532)/[#59894](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59894). R7b explicitly disables pinned eager replay. Activate and integrate compatible graph path. | Prefill mechanism **moderate**, R7b benefit **low**; quality/graph gate then integration. | Read-only support gate, cold/hit/128-boundary quality smoke → matched c384 parent vs integrated candidate. | Medium/high port and image qualification; smoke/startup unknown; 1.2 GPU-h traffic. |
| **3** | [H02: conditional MegaMoE EPLB](hypotheses/H02.md): replicate hot experts to reduce slow-rank TPOT; extra HBM and rebalance stalls. | Pinned MegaMoE has EPLB hooks; default off. [DeepSeek EPLB](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/EPLB) supports mechanism, but R7b expert skew unknown. Activate only after route evidence. | Mechanism **moderate**, R7b benefit **low**; trace/placement replay first. | Parent expert/rank timing trace plus CPU assignment replay → matched c384 parent vs one qualified EPLB config. | Low analysis, medium activation; 1.2 GPU-h traffic if promoted. |
| **4** | [H05: bounded token-prefix placement](hypotheses/H05.md): fewer repeated-prefix misses across engines and ranks; hot-key imbalance possible. | [Preble](https://arxiv.org/html/2407.00023) and [SGLang gateway](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/sgl-model-gateway/src/policies/cache_aware.rs) show mechanism. Router session IDs scatter repeated Zipf keys, but aggregate 0.77 hit share gives no avoidable-miss proof. Add exact-token hash, two-level rank hint and bounded spill. | Locality mechanism **moderate**, R7b benefit **low**; trace-gated design. | Parent request-prefix/rank/cache join and CPU placement replay → matched c384 parent vs router policy. | Medium router/trace work, CPU replay cheap; 1.2 GPU-h traffic if promoted. |
| **5** | [H03: FlashInfer CuteDSL MegaMoE](hypotheses/H03.md): potential large-step prefill throughput; small decode may regress, weight conversion changes arithmetic. | Pinned backend can load same MXFP4 checkpoint through requantization. [FlashInfer microbench](https://flashinfer.ai/2026/09/22/mega-moe.html) shows a small-token loss and different V4/EP8 gains. Select backend, qualify NVSHMEM/runtime and quality. | Shape mechanism **moderate**, R7b net benefit **low–moderate**; component/runtime gate. | Read-only dependency check then four-B200 EP4 representative shape/quality component test → matched c384 fixed-backend comparison. | Medium runtime/memory/quality work; component minutes after setup; 1.2 GPU-h traffic if promoted. |
| **6** | [H06: DP-coordinated adaptive DSpark k](hypotheses/H06.md): avoid low-value draft/verify work as load/acceptance changes; graph/coordination overhead. | [Nightjar](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.22420) and [SpecDec++](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.19715) support adaptivity elsewhere. Pinned vLLM disables dynamic k at DP>1. New synchronized k-tier selection, graph dispatch and fallback are required. | General mechanism **moderate**, R7b benefit **low**; source design after trace. | Parent acceptance/cost trace and CPU policy replay → correctness/graph smoke → c384 policy vs fixed k5 (optional k2 arm). | High implementation; 1.2–1.8 GPU-h traffic plus unknown build/startup. |

The order favors cheap discriminating checks and the active node's likely operating range. It is conditional: evidence of no rank skew would remove H04/H02, no avoidable repeated-prefix misses would remove H05, and a strict bit-identical output contract would remove H01. H03's published crossover makes its fixed backend a component question before service promotion. No numeric R7b speedup is forecast.

## Exploration coverage and alternatives

| Direction | Selected or reason not selected |
| --- | --- |
| V4.1 replay / graph integration | **H01 selected**; separate from prior batch's H01 decode candidate-selection port, which stays prior work and is **not counted**. |
| EP prefill/decode scheduling | **H04 selected.** Active-demand long-prefill chunk cap (S2 in [schedule note](notes/schedule_spec.md)) is a distinct cheap fallback if a parent trace shows long mixed steps without rank skew; it lost a slot to broader mechanisms because current vLLM already chunks/priors decodes and R7b miss-step evidence is absent. |
| Speculation | **H06 selected** for draft-work adaptation. Adaptive **verification** activation (S3) lost to [issue #59970](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/59970)'s backend-specific graph crash and weak safe-mode gain; MegaAttention compatibility remains a future question. Prior #59468 slot fix is unlikely to bind R7b's 16K budget. |
| Prefix KV / routing | **H05 selected.** One-use KV probationary eviction is distinct but lower readiness; R7b has no hot-prefix eviction evidence and hybrid-cache correctness is costly. Generic waiting-queue affinity had a near-zero correct async result in [RFC #42185](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/42185). CPU/SSD KV offload needs a larger working-set case and DSV4 layout fixes. |
| MoE and Engram | **H02/H03 selected.** Direct DeepEP dispatch is inactive on the measured DeepGEMM MegaMoE path. Private-THP Engram #59923 had weak comparable small-row DEP4 effects; B200 Engram threshold adaptation remains a profile-gated alternative. Native W4A4 port overlaps H03's precision/backend question. |
| Prefill/decode disaggregation | [RFC #57383](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/57383) is design-only and would change topology, weight residency and transport; lower readiness/cost-effectiveness for this one-node batch than H01 replay activation. |

Sources and exact PR states/SHAs, code paths, positive/negative literature and access limits: [sources](sources.md), [delegated notes](notes/schedule_spec.md), [cache/routing](notes/cache_route.md), [MoE/backend](notes/moe_backend.md), [bounded replay](notes/bounded_replay.md). [Self-review](review.md) records substantive objections/revisions against the full rubric. **Next human checkpoint:** select a diagnostic/experiment and its execution scope; this run did not build, patch serving code or use GPUs. Process lesson for the meta coordinator: preserve the new batch's explicit source-path qualification and rank/cache/acceptance trace gates before promoting headline PR gains; no change to `research/META.md` was made here.

# Decision — five new mechanisms; one-idea shortfall

Requested **six source-research ideas**. Five distinct conditional mechanisms survived; **shortfall: one**. Existing activations/unchanged ports are useful comparators below and do not fill the quota. No improvement is measured and no experiment was launched. [Brief](brief.md) · [sources](sources.md) · [self-review](review.md) · [matched experiment contract](notes/experiment-contract.md).

The strongest next research screen is **H04's exposed metadata cost versus simple fusion**; H01 is the smaller scheduler prototype if its precise alignment-blocking pattern occurs. **No candidate is currently ready to promise a correct implementation and matched serving result overnight.** H01 is the only plausible single-evening prototype (estimated4–8h) after its incidence gate; the other source implementations are day-scale. A cheap relevance screen is available tonight, but its setup estimate is not measured GPU duration. The other mechanisms need prerequisites or appreciably more engineering. Ranking combines relevance, falsifiability and total cost, separately from source novelty.

| Rank/card | New behavior and intended c32 effect | Evidence / decisive unknown | Cheapest isolated test → matched point | Cost and eligibility |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1 [H04 persistent GDN descriptors](hypotheses/H04.md)|Retain unchanged state mappings across decode steps; potential TPOT/output-rate gain, possible invalidation overhead.|Exact image rebuilds descriptors; ordinary decode is active. Unknown exposed critical-path time after async and simple fusion.|Short c32 profile plus stock/fused/reuse metadata sequence; stop if fusion removes headroom. Then same trial10 c32 three-arm comparison.|Screen setup0.5–1day; prototype1–3days; capture/start separately; ~6min first three-arm point wall time+prep. **Cheap screen eligible; implementation conditional.**|
|2 [H01 alignment-fit bypass](hypotheses/H01.md)|Use leftover token budget for fitting tails after alignment-zero head; potential TTFT/capacity gain, TPOT/long-head regression possible.|Exact waiting-loop break; seq64/c32 does not prove waiting+stranded-budget+fitting-follower coincidence.|CPU branch/progress cases and short original c32 incidence diagnostic. Then parent/static2048/candidate c32.|Prototype estimate4–8h, not a readiness promise; Python source helper insertion needed. ~6min point wall time+starts/prep. **CPU test eligible; serving only if incidence.**|
|3 [H03 selected interior checkpoints](hypotheses/H03.md)|Materialize demanded sub-page GDN+conv+attention checkpoint without whole-model split; potential prefill/TTFT saving, export/memory cost.|Image tail-only boundary gap and Marconi/PR evidence; warmup+fine matching may already cover useful prefixes.|CPU exact token/checkpoint join against fine matching. If incremental reuse exists, isolated continuation oracle. Then fine-match parent/exporter c32.|Gate0.5–1day; prototype3–7days/integration1–2weeks; JIT/build separate. **CPU gate eligible; no overnight implementation.**|
|4 [H02 committed-prefix followers](hypotheses/H02.md)|Suppress duplicate in-flight prefill using producer-completion/generation dependency; possible compute saving, deliberate wait risk.|SGLang heuristic exists, event-safe hybrid adaptation new. Frozen64-prefix warmup may eliminate opportunity.|CPU residual-prefix join, then simultaneous sibling-miss incidence. Parent/heuristic/candidate only if useful.|Gate1–3h; implementation1–3days; normal startup; pair~4min+prep. **CPU gate eligible; low exact-workload confidence.**|
|5 [H05 ragged GDN MTP verification](hypotheses/H05.md)|Per-request verify budgets plus coherent device hybrid commit; possible TPOT/output gain, backend/draft/state overhead.|Real metadata/FA2 gap; safe MTP and useful c32 heterogeneity unproven.|Safe fixed-MTP acceptance/physical-bucket cost diagnostic, optimistic bound, component state/graph test. Same-stack fixed/ragged c32 plus original anchor.|4–8engineering days or more; backend/MRV2/capture startup substantial. **Diagnostic conditional on MTP safety; no overnight implementation.**|

Times are estimates. Historical c32 point was~117–120s, excluding server setup and cache preparation; startup/compile/drain are additional and must be timed. A single matched point is provisional. Original BF16 model, workload bodies, forced lengths, warmup, streaming/API, concurrency and request-level scorer remain the route to comparable p90TTFT/p90TPOT/output-rate points. No cold, low-concurrency or operation-only result substitutes. Repeats/order/drift, neighboring loads and a distinct final split follow only promising results.

## Useful upgrades and controls — excluded from five

| Existing solution | Role |
|---|---|
|Fine-prefix matching activation|Strongest H03 control; may remove all justification for new snapshots. Previous batch H01 remains a cheap deployment experiment after checkpoint/quality gate.|
|Fused align metadata gather, PR38020/SGLang-style refresh|Strongest H04 control and potentially simpler useful upgrade. Closed PR requires compatibility qualification; unchanged port is not source novelty.|
|Safe fixed native MTP, uniform adaptive depth, eligible runner/attention backend|H05 prerequisites/controls; prior activation is not re-counted.|
|Static2048 prefill cap and ordinary shortest-residual ordering|H01 practical controls; prior pressure-prefill policy remains historical, not forced into this round.|
|Regular all-mode checkpoint export / FlashInfer prefill / fused ordinary GDN / FP8|Existing ports/activations remain alternative deployment investigations; precision change needs its own quality dimension.|

## Exploration and why a sixth did not survive

| Direction | Outcome |
|---|---|
|Queue fit/fairness|H01 new narrow legal-work bypass; generic cache affinity discarded after correct-async null result; output-length pairing has irrelevant capacity assumptions and negative real-EOS evidence.|
|In-flight prefix reuse / stateless compute dedup|H02 completion-aware adaptation retained conditionally. Hybrid RadixMLP costs more and shares the unproven cold-duplicate opportunity; not padded into another slot.|
|Hybrid state materialization|H03 selective export retained; raw fine-match/all-mode activation/port excluded. No generic eviction claim with zero recorded c32 preemptions.|
|Host/GPU metadata|H04 reuse/invalidation retained. Raw gather fusion excluded as unchanged solution.|
|Speculative verification|H05 coherent ragged integration retained conditionally. Native MTP, batch-only adaptiveK, ReplaySSM/TreeWY ports excluded as repeats/prerequisites.|
|Multi-step execution|Two-step decode lease discarded: no exposed-gap evidence beyond existing async and MRV2, while admission/cancellation/graph work is substantial.|
|Allocator/precision/communication|Allocator prototype evidence does not establish runtime value here; precision flags repeat prior batch; dense TP1 has no MoE inter-GPU communication opportunity.|

Review was lead **self-review** with delegated research, not independent approval. Recommendations to coordinator: preserve source-novelty and exact-workload-value as separate judgments; save null activation/comparator outcomes, and require current-image traces before escalating a helper operation into a serving claim. No skills, prior batches, serving code or dependencies were changed by this worker; no GPU was launched. Human selection remains the next stage.
